Cropped (20 pt "G" region, unmodified pixels) from Google's official
"Sign in with Google" branding assets (signin-assets.zip, iOS PNG @3x/@4x,
Theme Light/Dark, Show text=No, Shape=Square), downloaded from
https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines on 2026-11-10.
Light/dark variants sit on Google's button fills (#FFFFFF / #131314), which
the sign-in button uses, so the crop edges match the button.
